de.abas.eks.jfop.remote

Class FO

  • Object
    • EKS
      • FO

  • public class FO
extends EKS
    This class makes FO access available whereby the individual methods have respective command-specific parameter lists. In contrast to this, all methods of the class EKS, from which this class inherits, have a standard string parameter.

      • setCommandLanguage

        public static void setCommandLanguage(int cmdlang)
        Sets the FO command language. The default for this is set in the configuration data record. JFOPs which are to be transferred to other installations should therefore always call this method (at the start of the program).
        Parameters:
        cmdlang - command language, permitted values are CMDLANG_GERMAN and CMDLANG_ENGLISH

      • getCommandLanguage

      • links

        public static void links(int randLinks,
                         boolean randInMm,
                         boolean randVerschieben)
                  throws FOPException
        Set left margin to a specific value or move (in millimeters, if required).
        Parameters:
        randLinks - value of how much the left margin should be moved (negative values are also permitted) or the value to which the left margin should be set (only positive number values)
        randInMm - "true" means that the value randLinks has a millimeter specification (otherwise randLinks specifies the column number)
        randVerschieben - "true" means that the margin should be moved (otherwise the margin is set to randLinks)
        Throws:
        FOPException

      • links

        public static void links(int randLinks,
                         boolean randInMm,
                         boolean randVerschieben,
                         int offset)
                  throws FOPException
        Set left margin or move using indent/move forward (also optionally in millimeters).
        Parameters:
        randLinks - value by which the left margin should be moved (negative values are also permitted) or value to which the left margin should be set (only positive number values)
        randInMm - "true" means that the value randLinks has a millileter specification (otherwise randLinks specifies the column number)
        randVerschieben - "true" means that the margin should be moved (otherwise the margin is set to randLinks)
        offset - value by which the first line of a paragraph should be moved (positive values have the effect that the first line is indented, negative values move it forward)
        Throws:
        FOPException

      • menue

        public static int menue(String title,
                        String[] alternatives,
                        int line,
                        int column,
                        int highlighted)
                 throws FOPException
        Display a selection menu, whereby the initial active selection option and the positioning of the menu (only works in the ASCII interface) can be specified.
        Parameters:
        title - menu title
        alternatives - [] Integrates the required menu options. As line with index 0 a formatting specification can be made for the column by column display in the first line after the title as in the FO; this line does not count for the return value.
        line - specifies the number of written blank lines (before the menu selection box)
        column - column number where the menu selection box should start
        highlighted - number of alternative which is initially selected
        Returns:
        number of the selected line, 0 if aborted.
        Throws:
        FOPException

      • eingabe

        public static int eingabe(String fopName,
                          boolean endCalledException)
                   throws FOPException
        Executes an embedded FOP. The specified program is executed within the Java program as an FO program. When it is ended, the control is given back to the Java program.
        Parameters:
        fopName - the FO program to be executed
        endCalledException - if true, an EndCalledException is generated, if the FOP has called the command .END, also with ".END 0" or ".END .".
        If false, no Exception is generated if ".END" runs through. In this case ".END", ".END 0" and a ".CONTINUE" output the return value 0 on the top level. This call is equivalent to FO.eingabe(String).
        Returns:
        exit status of executed FO programs according to the FO definition, i.e. ".end" and ".continue" and EOF mean exit status 0.
        Throws:
        FOPException - if the embedded FOP cancels or is not executable
        EndCalledException - if the embedded FOP or the called subprogram call ".end" and endCalledException==true is valid.
